title: Web standards come before speed
outcome: Accessible HTML and predictable browser behavior are the cheapest foundation for performance.

verificationSteps: Başlık hiyerarşisini ve form etiketlerini kontrol et

body:
Making a modern interface fast is not only about shrinking the bundle. The browser should understand the page, keyboard users should be able to operate it, and the interface should retain its meaning on a poor connection.

Semantic HTML, form labels, visible focus, and a clear heading hierarchy are often treated as cleanup work. They should be designed as early as the component API.

Standards reduce surprises. That pays off in performance, testing, and the cost of maintaining the product over time.
